tasks.title: Document the prompt settings API
tasks.request: Document the prompt settings API in `dashboard/README.md`. Add a short section that covers `GET`, `PUT`, and `DELETE /api/settings/prompt`, the JSON body (`prompt`), the response shape, where the prompt is stored (`/data/prompt.json` in the `dashboard-data` volume), and that `Reset to built-in` deletes the custom prompt. Keep the existing README structure and style. Do not change code.

tasks.title: Design M4nhattan real data
tasks.request: Write a design/ADR for replacing the M4nhattan dashboard's mock service, log and notification data with real data. Do not change runtime code, dashboard components or compose files. Cover: candidate data sources (Home Assistant, Docker, host processes and existing server endpoints), how the dashboard container reaches them without exposing the Docker socket, API contracts and TypeScript data types, refresh or streaming strategy, loading/empty/failure states, localhost/no-auth security limits, and a recommended migration path with follow-up tasks. Produce `docs/m4nhattan-real-data.md`, referencing the current `dashboard/src/lib/mock-data.ts` shapes and relevant docs. Include alternatives, open questions and explicit non-goals. Keep it actionable, in English, and do not implement the migration.
